implementation: Ubuntu 22.04 Kernel Crypto API Cryptographic Module (KW_CPACF_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: KW generic C non-optimized block mode using CPACF AES implementation.
